target.title: Add Claw doctor diagnostics
target.body:
## Summary

- Adds a `core/doctor/claws-state` check for applied Claw provenance drift.
- Reports missing, modified, unreadable, oversized, or unsafe Claw-managed workspace files; orphaned Claw refs without an apply record; missing, disabled, or changed inline MCP server config; and any future persisted connector refs as unsupported until OpenClaw has a stable connector setup path.
- Wires the check into both structured doctor lint and the regular ordered doctor contribution flow.

## Stack

- RFC: openclaw/rfcs#27
- Previous PR: #102406
- Base branch: `user/giodl/claws-pr9-mcp`

## Validation

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/doctor.test.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/provenance.test.ts src/claws/artifact-installers.test.ts src/claws/workspace.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle-state.test.ts src/claws/doctor.test.ts src/state/openclaw-state-db.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/cli/plugins-cli.uninstall.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs`
- `codex review -c model=gpt-5.5 --uncommitted`

## Real behavior proof

- Created a temporary workspace-only Claw, applied it with `claws apply --workspace ... --yes --json`, modified the Claw-managed `SOUL.md`, then ran `doctor --lint --only core/doctor/claws-state --json`.
- Result: command exited `1` with `core/doctor/claws-state` warning for `claws.doctor-proof.workspace.soul` and message `Claw-managed workspace file has changed since apply`.

## Not tested

- Full `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs --noEmit --pretty false`; this linked WSL worktree is missing `node_modules/.bin/tsgo`, so the script exits with `spawnSync .../node_modules/.bin/tsgo ENOENT` before typechecking.
